title: Support OpenAI sources
body:
### Description

As far as I can see, we can't pass the include sources header through the library:
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search#sources
namely the ability to pass 
`include: ["web_search_call.action.sources"]`
through to the openai library.  

I can see we restrict to 3 other includes:
https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/c37bc3b663b52b9a7a7453e186c2651a7f42d61e/packages/openai/src/responses/openai-responses-language-model.ts#L1419-L1426

I'm not 100% sure yet where the sources appear in the response, but if I get time, I'll run a test and see what the structure is.

We currently get the citations, but was keen to get the sources as well.

### AI SDK Version

ai: 5.0.38
@ai-sdk/openai: 2.0.27

linked_prs.title: fix (provider/openai): send sources action as include
linked_prs.body:
## Background

`web_search_call.action.sources` was not sent to the OpenAI API.

## Summary

* check if tool is `web_search` or `web_search_preview` and use correct name in tool calls and results
* automatically add `web_search_call.action.sources` include when either web search tool is present
* remove redundant tests

## Manual Verification

- [x] run `examples/ai-core/src/generate-text/openai-web-search-tool.ts`

## Tasks

- [x] add include flag automatically
- [x] investigate why there are no tool calls / results in the generate case
- [x] update generate test (outputs, check flag)
- [x] add easy way to record raw chunks and use them in tests
- [x] investigate why stream does not send sources
- [x] update stream test (outputs, check flag)
- [x] update examples
- [x] changeset

## Related Issues

Closes #8528

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns passing specific parameters ("include sources header") to the OpenAI LLM provider, which is an "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" agent issue. It directly relates to LLM provider integration and model response handling within an agent system.
